rows.row: A send repeated under one idempotency key on one thread: one book in the core send operation, scoped by thread, key and principal class. A repeat delivers nothing and answers the delivery's identifiers (message id, turn id) and its kind, never message text; the kind is the one recorded when the first call was answered until the truthful-delivery slice (D1) merges, and the delivery's current kind from then on, as the first-party design's amendment 16 states; a different message under the same key answers the typed conflict with no text from either message
